name: gs-term
description: Reproducible development toolchain for gs-term (Bun app + Rust semantic helper + SolidLSP bridge). Devbox is the reproducibility oracle, NOT a product requirement.

init_hook: unset CC CXX CC_FOR_TARGET CXX_FOR_TARGET AR AS LD READELF NM STRIP RANLIB || true
[ -x "$PWD/.devbin/bin/bun" ] || echo 'bun not bootstrapped yet — run: devbox run bootstrap'
command -v cargo >/dev/null || echo 'cargo not found — rustup-managed Rust 1.98.0 required (see scripts/README.md)'
